item.title: Domain data reveals income of $93,600 is needed to rent in the Mid West without being in rental stress
item.description: Renters in the Mid West need to be raking in an income of more than $93,000 in order to lease a property comfortably and not be in rental stress.

item.title: Geraldton band RATSALAD takes home top regional musical gong at WA Music Awards
item.description: Gero band RATSALAD took home regional act of the year at the WA Music Awards at Walyalup Fremantle Arts Centre on Wednesday night.

item.title: Payment of public transport fares with credit or debit cards to be rolled out in Geraldton before end of year
item.description: Geraldton public transport users will be able to tag on and off with their credit or debit cards or with their smart device before the end of the year.

item.title: Grant Russell elected for a second stint as president of the Great Northern Football League
item.description: The Great Northern Football League will have a new man at the helm for season 2026 and beyond, with Grant Russell re-elected for his second stint as president.

item.title: Shops prepared as thousands set to flock to Marine Terrace for annual Christmas on the Terrace
item.description: The annual Christmas on the Terrace markets set to brought the community together for an evening of festive fun.

item.title: Jarrod Heath Edwards: Geraldton man jailed for four years over hit-and-run of three-year-old boy
item.description: A Geraldton man has been jailed for four years over a hit-and-run while impaired by meth and cannabis that left a three-year-old boy with ‘catastrophic’ and ‘life-endangering’ injuries.

item.title: Chapman Valley fire: Residents in Bowes, Howatharra, Oakajee told to stay alert as bushfire contained
item.description: An emergency bushfire alert in the Mid West has been downgraded as fireys strengthen containment lines around the blaze.

item.title: Thunderstorms cause mass power outage affecting 24,000 homes, businesses in Geraldton and Mid West
item.description: The majority of the almost 25,000 homes and businesses across Geraldton and the Mid West faced with power cuts over the weekend have had power restored after an extended outage that lasted up to 24 hours.

item.title: Tens of thousands have power restored in Geraldton, Mid West but 24-hour outages comes at a cost
item.description: Households and businesses across Geraldton and the Mid West are counting the costs after the weekend’s massive power outage, which for most left them in the dark for more than 24 hours.

item.title: Perth weather: Western Power outages still impacting more than 15,000 West Aussies half a day after storm
item.description: Restoration times range from midday to 8pm on Monday for some homes in Perth.
